name: Recognizer - Tron (1982)
description:
This is a Classic Recognizer from Tron (1982) built for a project I am working on and I am now sharing with you. 

Formats: Blender and FBX

You can use it however you want, but remember, Tron is a property owned by Disney, so I have to say: For editorial purposes only.

Have fun!!
